sec.title: September 4 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 750)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial story arcs, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 4** across Hollywood pin-up icon Betty Grable and Mel Blanc joining Kay Kyser on *G.I. Journal* for AFRS, James Pierce starring in Part 70 of Edgar Rice Burroughs' *The Diamond of Asher* on *Tarzan*, Tennessee Ernie Ford sharing motoring safety advice on *The Ford Road Show*, an aging steam engineer braving trestle washouts on *Heartbeat Theatre* for The Salvation Army, Arlene Francis on *Betty and Bob*, and John Brown's Broadway gambler antics on *The Damon Runyon Theater*, Betty Grable & Mel Blanc (1943), James Pierce (1933), Tennessee Ernie Ford (1957), and Arlene Francis (1933–1960):
